decisive_spans.text: Opacification on right frontal sinus, right ethmoid sinus, and right maxillary sinus and expansion of the right frontal sinus and right ethmoid sinus without any bone destruction

response.rationale: The imaging findings of opacification and expansion of the right frontal sinus, without bone destruction, are highly characteristic of a mucocele. While frontal sinusitis (D4) is supported by opacification and ring enhancement, the expansion of the sinus is a key feature distinguishing a mucocele from simple sinusitis. Chronic frontal sinusitis (D3) is contradicted by the lack of bone destruction, which is often seen in chronic inflammatory processes. Churg-Strauss syndrome (D2) is less likely due to the absence of systemic symptoms.
